patch_description: This version uses a broader family of layered and staggered hexagonal seeds, vectorized squared-distance constraints with analytic Jacobians, and a two-stage refinement strategy. First-stage SLSQP runs discover promising contact graphs. Their center locations are then re-evaluated with a linear program for the best radii at fixed centers, ranked using both objective value and active-contact signatures, and the most structurally distinct candidates receive a final nonlinear polish. A final global safety scaling guarantees strict containment and non-overlap despite numerical tolerances.
